content: Three.js fog fades fragments toward one color by camera distance (scene.fog = Fog or FogExp2). The standard stylized trick is to set fog color = horizon/sky color so distant geometry dissolves into the sky; default single-color fog is considered flat, so advanced setups mix a near fog color and a far/horizon color by fogFactor (Sneha Belkhale fog hacks article has shader patches). For top-down cameras where the far plane is close, linear Fog with near set beyond the combat readability radius is preferred over FogExp2. Matching fog to a sky gradient background is a recurring three.js forum topic - keep both driven from the same color source. Sources: threejs.org docs/manual, discourse.threejs.org threads 52018/32789, snayss.medium.com.
